description: Platform identity-provider policy for OIDC token validation and RBAC claim mapping.
oidc_requirements: issuer must be HTTPS and must not use localhost
jwks_uri must be HTTPS and must not use localhost
at least one audience is required
algorithm must be an asymmetric JWT algorithm such as RS256 or ES256
claim_mapping_rules: subject_claim, display_name_claim, email_claim, and role_claim are required
role_map values must use the standard roles from rbac_policy.v1.json
admin role mappings require explicit admin_group_allowlist membership
notes: This policy validates configuration metadata only. Runtime token validation, login screens, sessions, and persistent user-role assignments belong to the platform backend.
